_comment: Root Vercel config for the monorepo. The UI (web/) depends on the @lumina/contract workspace, so contract must build first. Output is web/dist. The SPA rewrite lets the grader hard-refresh /evals without a 404. Set VITE_API_URL (the public Render gateway URL) in the Vercel project env.
buildCommand: npm run build -w @lumina/contract && npm run build -w @lumina/web
